newsitem.title: PERU: Lima shrs end mixed, foreigners buy as locals sell.
newsitem.headline: Lima shrs end mixed, foreigners buy as locals sell.

text.p: Shares on the Lima stock exchange closed narrowly mixed Tuesday as foreign investors entered the market to buy stocks being sold by local players taking profits on recent gains, brokers said.
Prices were likley to be broadly stable Wednesday, they added.
Tuesday, the General Index fell 0.2 percent to 1,522.9 points, while the blue-chip Selective Index rose 0.2 percent to 2,175.4 points.
In a total of 1,752 trades, volume was estimated at 31.1 million soles ($12.0 million), brokers said.

"It was notable that despite local investors taking profits, money came in from outside -- albeit in a selective manner -- to brake the technical correction," said an analyst at a leading local brokerage, who asked not to be named.
Benchmark Telefonica del Peru gained 0.54 percent closing at 5.55 soles on volume of 1.79 million shares.
Cement company Cementos Lima closed up 1.17 percent at 4.32 soles on volume of 1.98 million shares.
